title: Independence of Namibia
note: Lodge: Angola-Namibia settlement of 1988-90 followed Cuito Cuanavale and shaped South Africa's own transition; Namibian independence 21 March 1990.

title: Founding of the Women's National Coalition and the Women's Charter
note: Founded 26 April 1992 by the ANC Women's League after women were absent from CODESA; Maritz (New Contree 2011), Hassim (Social Research 2002). Under-recorded women's history.

title: Collapse and reincorporation of the Bantustans (Bophuthatswana and Ciskei), 1994
note: TRC Vol 2 ch 7: Bophuthatswana March 1994 AWB intervention and Ciskei collapse; homeland peoples' experience.

title: Natives Land Act of 1913
note: TRC Vol 1: set in motion mass forced removal of African people; land dispossession is the main unreversed legacy. Include Khoisan and Indigenous dispossession in linked work.

title: Sebokeng police shooting of protesters, March 1990
note: 17 killed, 447 injured per TRC Vol 2 ch 7; confirm exact date from a primary source.

title: Presentation of the TRC Final Report to President Mandela
note: Presented 29 October 1998; includes victim statements, women's hearings, and amnesty decisions.
